annotations.title: Move an account to another brand

description: Move one connected social account from one brand you own to another without reconnecting it on the network (hosted app, Studio and Pro). Queued posts for that account on the source brand are cancelled, and its connection is re-sealed under the destination brand. Ask the user for explicit confirmation first, naming the account, source brand and destination brand.

accountId.description: Connected account id from accounts_list on the source brand to move.

fromBrandId.description: Source brand id from brands_list that currently holds the connected account.

toBrandId.description: Destination brand id from brands_list (owned by this login) to move the connected account into.

name: brands_move_account
title: Move an account to another brand
